Interactive cells with ggiraph

Source: R/interactive.R
calor_interactive.Rd

Turns the cells into 'ggiraph' interactive tiles with tooltips and linked highlighting. Render with calor_girafe() or ggiraph::girafe().

Usage

calor_interactive(
  tooltip = NULL,
  data_id = c("cell", "row", "col"),
  tracks = TRUE
)

Arguments

tooltip

NULL for "row, column, value", or a function of (row, col, value) returning a character vector.

data_id

What highlights together on hover: "cell", "row" or "col".

tracks

Make categorical annotation tracks interactive too. With data_id = "row" or "col", hovering a track cell highlights its row or column in the heatmap.

Value

An object to add to a ggcalor() plot with +.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggiraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
  m <- matrix(rnorm(50), 10, 5, dimnames = list(paste0("g", 1:10), paste0("s", 1:5)))
  p <- ggcalor(m) + calor_interactive(data_id = "row")
  calor_girafe(p)
}
